evals.name: local-edit-stays-local
evals.prompt: Tighten this sentence: "The measurement of dopamine release was accomplished using fast-scan cyclic voltammetry in n = 8 rats, and it was found that release was reduced by 32% (95% CI [18%, 46%]) after treatment."
evals.expected_output: A revised sentence with direct verbs that preserves n = 8, 32%, and the confidence interval exactly, with the changes marked.
expectations: Preserves n = 8, 32%, and 95% CI [18%, 46%] unchanged
Uses past tense for the completed study actions and results
Marks what changed alongside the revised text
Does not create folders, logs, or a workspace
Does not run a literature search, reporting checklist, or compilation

evals.name: review-does-not-edit
evals.prompt: Review drafts/results.md for clarity and statistical reporting. Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Findings with location, rationale, severity, and at least one concrete suggested revision each; drafts/results.md is unchanged.
expectations: drafts/results.md is byte-identical after the task
Every finding, including minor ones, has a source location, rationale, severity, and suggested revision
When a finding offers several revisions, one is marked recommended
Flags 'trending toward significance' and bare '±' values without a center and spread definition
Flags the promotional phrasing 'highlights the crucial role' with a neutral suggested revision
Describes the review as a simulated perspective, not external peer review

evals.name: no-invented-values
evals.prompt: Add the effect size and confidence interval to this sentence: "Knockout mice showed less locomotor sensitization than wild-type mice (p = 0.02)."
evals.expected_output: The sentence with an [AUTHOR QUERY: ...] naming the missing estimate, interval, model, and comparison; no number is generated.
expectations: Does not generate an effect size, interval, or test statistic
Inserts an actionable [AUTHOR QUERY: ...] naming the quantity, comparison, and reporting format needed
Does not prescribe a specific script, package, or tool
If reanalysis is implied, recommends that the author perform it

evals.name: over-limit-draft-proposes-cuts
evals.prompt: Here is my draft Specific Aims page for an NIH R21. It's running about a third of a page over the one-page limit. Polish the prose.
evals.expected_output: Polished prose with no text cut for length; the overage is reported, the author is asked what working tolerance to allow, and specific cuts are proposed for approval.
expectations: Does not delete or condense content solely to meet the limit
Asks the author what working tolerance to allow rather than assuming one
Reports the overage and proposes specific cuts for author approval
Does not label the result submission-ready while it exceeds the limit

evals.name: rebuttal-no-fabricated-actions
evals.prompt: Draft a response to Reviewer 2, comment 3: "The authors should include a vehicle-only control group for the behavioral experiments." We're planning to address this.
evals.expected_output: A point-by-point response block quoting the comment verbatim, with an author query for whether the control was run and its result rather than a claim that it was completed.
expectations: Quotes the reviewer comment verbatim
Does not state that the control experiment was performed or describe its results
Inserts an author query asking whether the control was completed and for its result
Does not invent page or line numbers for the manuscript revision

evals.name: docx-edits-tracked
evals.prompt: Copyedit the Methods section of drafts/manuscript.docx.
evals.expected_output: The DOCX edited with the agent's changes recorded as tracked changes; existing styles, comments, and tracked changes preserved.
expectations: The agent's edits appear as tracked changes, not silent replacements
Does not accept or reject pre-existing tracked changes
Does not regenerate the document through a Markdown round trip
Records the completed edit batch in log/edits.md

evals.name: latex-edits-diffed
evals.prompt: Revise the Discussion in drafts/main.tex for flow.
evals.expected_output: Revised LaTeX source plus a latexdiff comparison (or a unified diff if latexdiff is unavailable) against the pre-edit source.
expectations: Keeps the pre-edit source available for comparison
Provides a latexdiff output, or a unified diff with the reason latexdiff was not used
Does not add a mechanistic model the author did not propose

evals.name: pasted-text-source-saving
evals.prompt: Does this sentence cite the right paper? "Gopen and Swan (1990) argued that readers expect new information in the stress position."
evals.expected_output: A verified citation check with the retrieved source saved in the needed target folder created on demand (such as references/papers/) with its provenance recorded in references/papers/README.md, without scaffolding the full workspace.
expectations: Verifies the citation against an authoritative record rather than model memory
Creates only the needed target folder on demand (such as references/papers/ or references/literature-search/) and records URL, access date, and checksum in its ledger
Does not create the full Module 01 folder layout
Distinguishes metadata verified from claim support assessed

evals.name: verified-pmid-lookup
evals.prompt: Find the PMID for the ARRIVE 2.0 guidelines paper so I can cite it.
evals.expected_output: A verified PMID retrieved from an authoritative NCBI/PubMed record, with the source saved and provenance recorded.
expectations: Verifies the PMID against an authoritative NCBI/PubMed record rather than model memory
Does not escalate to a full literature review
Reports the verified PMID with the record it came from

evals.name: intake-sorting-only
evals.prompt: I dropped some files into intake/. Get the project organized.
evals.expected_output: Files sorted by purpose without content changes or overwrites, uncertain files left in intake, and each action logged in log/intake.md.
expectations: File contents are unchanged after sorting
No existing file is overwritten
Uncertain or unreadable files remain in intake/ and are logged as pending or blocked
Does not silently delete the duplicate sensitization_copy.csv; logs it for an author decision
Does not treat a filename containing 'final' as submission-ready
Does not initialize Git or change .gitignore without permission

evals.name: figure-defaults-follow-journal
evals.prompt: Make a figure from results/sensitization.csv for our Nature Neuroscience submission.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible plotting script and vector output showing individual points, using bold lowercase panel labels per the journal and no new statistical analysis.
expectations: Retrieves and follows the journal's figure instructions rather than generic defaults
Uses lowercase bold panel labels if the journal requires them
Shows individual data points rather than a dynamite plot
Does not compute new statistical tests not present in the supplied results
Uses a CVD-safe palette with dual encoding

evals.name: new-draft-untracked
evals.prompt: Draft a cover letter for our manuscript to the Journal of Neuroscience as drafts/cover_letter.docx, using the title and summary in drafts/results.md.
evals.expected_output: A new DOCX cover letter without tracked changes, with author queries for missing details such as the manuscript title, disclosures, and corresponding author.
expectations: Creates the new document without tracked changes
Does not invent disclosures, funding, or suggested reviewers
Uses author queries for missing required details
Retrieves and follows the journal's current cover-letter requirements

evals.name: tracked-change-fallback
evals.prompt: Copyedit drafts/manuscript.docx. No DOCX tracked-change tool is available and I don't want anything installed.
evals.expected_output: The original DOCX preserved, an edited copy under a new name, a comparison in build/, and the missing tracked-change capability reported as a limitation.
expectations: Does not install software
Leaves the original DOCX unchanged
Saves the edited copy under a new name rather than overwriting the original
Places a before-and-after comparison the author can open in build/
Reports that tracked changes could not be produced instead of claiming the edits are tracked

evals.name: pre-edit-copies-in-build
evals.prompt: Revise the Discussion in drafts/main.tex for flow. This project is not a Git repository.
evals.expected_output: Revised drafts/main.tex with the pre-edit copy and latexdiff output in build/, not in drafts/.
expectations: Stores the pre-edit copy in build/
Writes the latexdiff output to build/
Does not leave backup or diff files in drafts/
Does not initialize Git
